name: Uzzah
overview: Uzzah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified uniquely as the son of Gera. His presence in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional narrative details or notes recorded about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Uzzah means "strong, fierce one," reflecting a Hebrew origin. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but is found in 1 Chronicles 8:7.
familyAndRelationships: Uzzah is explicitly recorded as the son of Gera, establishing his immediate family connection within the tribe of Benjamin. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family details.
scriptureSignificance: Uzzah's significance in the biblical record lies in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, as noted in 1 Chronicles. While the text does not elaborate on his personal deeds or spiritual role, his mention contributes to the biblical account of Israel's tribal lineage, underscoring the importance of family heritage in God's unfolding plan.
